scope.objective: Make mechanical-only and per-feature rollback policy-safe while preserving immutable pinned authority on active tasks.

compatibilityMatrix.case: known exact snapshot with ordinary broad/strict profile drift in either direction
explicit mechanical-only request for a non-mechanical active task
compatibilityMatrix.durability: one task/run-bound journal event plus deterministic handoff

compatibilityMatrix.case: explicit off value for a capability active in the pinned snapshot
compatibilityMatrix.durability: ordered capability ids are recorded and must all be off in the replacement snapshot

compatibilityMatrix.case: missing snapshot, unknown snapshot or manifest version, manifest drift, invalid snapshot, or cross-task identity
compatibilityMatrix.durability: legacy or incompatible evidence is never promoted

compatibilityMatrix.case: corrupt, duplicated, stale, or identity-mismatched disposition state
compatibilityMatrix.durability: resume, mutation, and replacement all fail closed

compatibilityMatrix.case: crash after journal disposition and before handoff write
compatibilityMatrix.durability: next session or user-input boundary reconstructs handoff before exposing task start

compatibilityMatrix.case: terminal task under later policy drift

invariants: The pinned Task Contract and authority snapshot are never rewritten during resume or rollback.
A persisted rollback receipt is sticky and cannot be reopened by restoring the old environment.
A replacement retains the model-attempt number, receives a fresh current snapshot, and inherits no changed-file or verifier evidence.
Mechanical-only is an authority ceiling: launch-time feature values may disable more but cannot re-enable an advanced capability.
The replacement tool is visible only after a durable handoff is written.
Operator status reports the authority resume disposition and bounded reason without a model turn.

rollback.mechanism: Select mechanical-only or set an explicit supported feature value to off. The active task is handed off; a clean replacement pins the new authority.
rollback.dataHandling: No Task Contract, terminal evidence, journal history, or provider evidence is deleted or relabeled.
rollback.operatorAction: If the journal disposition is blocked or handoff cannot be written, inspect the local journal/handoff and start no replacement until state is repaired.
